name: Teen Volunteers at Goleta Valley, Buellton and Solvang Libraries
what_you_do: Earn community service hours at the library. You can help with homework help, kids' craft programs, shelving and cleaning books, and staff projects. In summer many teens help with the Summer Reading Program.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Year-round. No deadline. Openings depend on what each branch needs, so check with your branch.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Volunteer Application for Teens, the Volunteer Waiver and the Insurance Waiver for your branch. Drop them off at the branch or email goletavalleylibrary@cityofgoleta.org, buelltonlibrary@cityofgoleta.org or solvanglibrary@cityofgoleta.org.
notes: The Goleta Valley Library also runs the Buellton and Solvang branches, and each has its own forms. The City of Goleta volunteer page also has a separate Volunteer Program Application for Minors for other city volunteer jobs such as Adopt-A-Park and Beautify Goleta.
